criteria.criterion: Calibration and routing metrics use actual eligible labels and matched route budgets, not predicted proof success as certification.
criteria.explanation: T3 calibration_error, route_value, and native_checked_useful_proof_coverage are null because eligible_native_label_count is 0. The calibration numerator is restricted to actual eligible native or version-matched verifier labels. T3 vs T2 uses the frozen three-seed common envelope; extra checker cost was unused. predicted_proof_success_used_as_certification is false on every result row. Isolation-probe calibration is retained only as a constructed diagnostic and is excluded from T3 certification. No row counts as a native checked proof or a claim-admissible table result.
